ctx.x: So John Rushford came to New York and was playing the Lafayette Theater and he was tearing things up. So Cab went down there and heard him and had him come to the Cotton Club and make an audition. And he came in and took our place in the Cotton Club while we went to Europe. And he opened with the Hill Wynn Show (PHONETIC). That was Jimmie Lunceford break
